2680.title: Automation safety documentation omits a terminal failure path
2680.rootCauseOneLine: The safety reference lists counter-based retries but omits the separate thread-keyed terminal disable path.
2680.proposedFix: Add the terminal target-thread behavior to the safety list and protect it with the focused documentation test.
2680.caveats: No live service was necessary. A temporary native-module ABI mismatch required the repository repair command before Vitest started.
